_doc: Champion registry. THE comparator for every new variant (campaign.yaml: comparator.primary=champion). Updated ONLY after a full cycle passes confirm + critic + audit. Hand-editing this file is a protocol violation; use autoresearch/update_sota.py.

_schema.champion: variant id that currently holds the dataset
_schema.pct_mean: feedforward percentage, mean over seeds, ROUNDED to 4 dp for display only
_schema.pct_mean_exact: the same mean at full precision. THIS is what update_sota.py compares the next candidate against (added 2026-08-15, D2): gating on the rounded pct_mean let H42 take the mouse championship from H36 on a delta of exactly 0.0 over bit-identical pools. Rows promoted before that date have no pct_mean_exact and fall back to pct_mean; they are left as recorded.
_schema.pct_std: std over the same seeds, rounded to 4 dp for display
_schema.pct_std_exact: the same std at full precision
_schema.role: role of the result JSONs used (implement|verify|confirm)
_schema.evidence: glob of results/*.json backing this row
_schema.caveats: list of short strings scoping the promotion (added 2026-08-15, D7). A row with a non-empty caveats list is NOT an unqualified win; read them before quoting the number. Written by update_sota.py --caveat.
_schema.forced: present only when the row was installed with update_sota.py --force, i.e. over a failing audit or an insufficient effect size. Its justification must exist in experiments/log.md.
_schema.wall_clock_s_approx: approximate per-run wall clock; recompute from JSONs before quoting

connectome.pipeline: H02 greedy-FAS warm-start -> run_rocket -> under-relaxed exact-gain sift (H35) -> alternating recursive SCC-topological block refinement <-> SHORT 2-sweep under-relaxed sift, re-allocated cycle counts (stage 4)

microns.pipeline: H02 greedy-FAS warm-start -> run_rocket -> under-relaxed exact-gain sift (H35) -> alternating recursive SCC-topological block refinement <-> SHORT 2-sweep under-relaxed sift, re-allocated cycle counts (stage 4)
caveats: Weak leg, recorded as such in findings.md #7: +0.0070 pp bought +107 s of wall clock, and microns now crosses the 3400 s runtime warn band (3398-3418 s against a 3600 s cap). Promoting connectome only and leaving microns on H36 was a defensible alternative verdict.

mouse.pipeline: H02 greedy-FAS warm-start -> run_rocket -> under-relaxed exact-gain sift (H35) -> alternating recursive SCC-topological block refinement <-> SHORT 2-sweep under-relaxed sift, re-allocated cycle counts (stage 4)
caveats: TIE, NOT A WIN. H42's delta over H36 on mouse is exactly 0.0 pp: the two confirm pools are bit-identical (n=20 seeds each, one distinct value, 92.91701410211007). This row changed hands only because update_sota.py compared the full-precision candidate mean against the champion's 4-decimal-ROUNDED pct_mean (92.917) - defect D2, fixed 2026-08-15. Under the minimum-effect-size gate now in force the promotion would be REFUSED. Backfilled 2026-08-15 as documentation; no score, seed list or n was altered.

Inherited from its predecessor H36, which took this row under PROTOCOL.md's 'GENERAL WIN with mouse caveat' decision-table row (added 2026-06-22, seven weeks before H36): H36's mouse non-inferiority bound was NOT cleared - protocol_ci_lower = -0.4047 against a -0.26 pp margin - even though its mouse score IMPROVED (+0.0152 pp over H30, 92.90180243 -> 92.91701410). The bound was mis-specified, not the result: it used the comparator's n only and floored sigma at the random-init baseline's 0.2624 pp, which demanded a +0.16 pp IMPROVEMENT to certify 'not worse' on a saturated 148-node graph. Re-specified 2026-08-15 (defect D4); under the pooled formula H36's mouse leg passes.

Provenance is not reproducible by checkout as of 2026-08-15: every H42 mouse confirm run is stamped 1865372b+dirty, a commit at which src/mfas/experiments/H42.py does not exist. audit.py --gate promotion FAILs on this (defect D6); a re-run from a clean checkout is required to close it.

Promoted as 'GENERAL WIN with mouse caveat' (PROTOCOL.md decision table, the checkmark-checkmark-cross row): the mouse non-inferiority bound was not cleared - protocol_ci_lower = -0.4047 vs the -0.26 pp margin - while the mouse score itself IMPROVED by +0.0152 pp over H30 with zero dispersion over 20 seeds. Recorded in findings.md #6 and filed at the time as queue item P04. The bound has since been re-specified (D4, 2026-08-15).
Provenance is not reproducible by checkout: all 36 H36 runs are stamped 9d43b977+dirty, a commit at which src/mfas/experiments/H36.py does not exist (defect D6, 2026-08-15).

connectome.reference_source: data/best_solution (35,463,823 / 41,912,141); independently reached by Vahidi 2025 (arXiv:2506.13799) with greedy + bounded-span insertion + SCC, no MIP
connectome.note: This is a REFERENCE, not a bound. Beating it is the stretch goal. It must never appear inside any algorithm.
